name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer building a portfolio of precious metal assets in Nevada, consistently rated among the world's top mining jurisdictions. The company's flagship Lapon Canyon Gold Project, located in the Walker Lane trend approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada, is being advanced under a $5 million exploration earn-in for a 50% interest, with significant drill intercepts including 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres and a maiden NI 43-101 resource targeted for 2026. Nevada Canyon also holds royalties and mineral properties across other high-grade Nevada districts including the Carlin Trend.
